Japan launches historic mission to Mars' moon Phobos

Japan has launched the Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission, a historic endeavor aimed at exploring Mars' moon Phobos and returning samples to Earth by 2031. The mission's objective is to collect samples from Phobos and bring them back for scientific analysis. The launch occurred on September 7, 2024.
